spec.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Amsterdam")   // or Europe/Berlin, Europe/Paris, etc.

from(bucket: "youless")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gas_actuals")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gas_m3_hr")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: (r._value / 12.0) * ${GasPrice} }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "This year"})

import "timezone"
import "date"

option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Amsterdam")   // change to your timezone if needed

from(bucket: "youless")
  |> range(start: date.add(d: -1y, to: v.timeRangeStart), stop: date.add(d: -1y, to: v.timeRangeStop))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gas_actuals")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gas_m3_hr")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: (r._value / 12.0) * ${GasPrice} }))
  |> timeShift(duration: 1y)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Last year"})
